decisions.mark: names the shell and CMake extensions, including CMakeLists.txt matched by file name rather than by extension
states that YAML and JSON are registered in the file set but carry NO symbols, so the two file groups are treated differently rather than alike
states that markdown is deliberately NOT given a path row, because it is prose and a path row would also count it as indexed source in coverage figures
concludes that an installation lacking the grammars DEGRADES rather than failing — the router consults a capability gate before routing, and those file types are then reported as not indexed
states that the root node type cannot be the discriminator, because shell shares its root with JavaScript and CMake shares its root with Rust
states that CMake's definition name is an ARGUMENT of the command rather than a named field of the node
states that a shell function is recorded with no argument list and no return, because the language has neither
states that both languages share ONE harvest partition, and gives the reason — a second partition would write an empty payload row per file per index
